data: Does the black line continue rising after the year 2000?

The black line represents the mean relative overlap over time. From the caption, we know that there is a decreasing trend starting around 1996. Looking at the right graph, the black line shows a peak around 1995 and then starts to decline. After 2000, the black line continues to decline, indicating that it does not continue rising after 2000. Therefore, the answer is no.
